canonical_lf_definition: sha256 over bytes after replacing every CRLF (0x0D 0x0A) with LF (0x0A); applied only to UTF-8 text files; equal to raw when the file is already LF.
verification_scope: run_dir files + docs-report + 5 figures + external audit artifacts

path_conventions.repo_referenced_paths: repo-relative (docs/... are repo-relative; deliverables are run-dir-relative)
path_conventions.external_artifact_paths: absolute machine-specific locators (EXT state dir, OpenVSP install, worktrees); sha256/bytes are authoritative; in-repo evidence is fully reproducible from repo + external sha manifest

self.note: self hash is omitted by design
